{{Quote|The wind carries with it the threat of an attack. My Wookiee friends have barely learned to harvest food, and yet now I must somehow teach them to create a militia. This will be a great challenge. May the Force be with them.|Qui-Gon Jinn on the training of bowcaster troopers prior to the attack on the gundark nest|audio=TrainingWarriors.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''Bowcaster troopers''', also referred to as '''bowcaster trooper recruits''' in their early training stages and '''heavy bowcaster recruits''' with even more training, were the basic [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in [[Army/Legends|armies]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They used [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]] to fight their enemies and defend their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Organization==
{{Quote|That's one trooper recruit, let's train a few more.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=OneRecruit.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Bowcaster troopers were members of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] trained at [[Barracks/Legends|troop centers]] to wield [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]], traditional Wookiee projectile weapons. Such Wookiees began their training as bowcaster trooper recruits, and as Wookiee tribes cultivated resources and improved their [[technology level]] recruits could progress to standard bowcaster troopers, then to heavy bowcaster troopers, and finally to [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating]] bowcaster troopers, who could wield a more advanced type of bowcaster that fired repeating bolts. Bowcaster troopers could be improved with technology from institutions such as [[War Center]]s and [[Fortress/Legends|fortresses]]. They were also more effective firing at long distances compared to short range combat.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
===Alaris Prime===
====Initial conflicts====
{{Quote|We must train warriors, then find and destroy the gundark nest.|Qui-Gon Jinn to Chewbacca|audio=GundarkDestruction.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Alaris_Prime_colonists.png|thumb|left|200px|Chewbacca and several bowcaster troopers on Alaris Prime]]
Bowcaster troopers saw action during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]],<ref name="GB" /> which occurred between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> A group of at least ten<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> bowcaster troopers were trained on the advice of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and led by the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|attack]] a [[Unidentified gundark nest|nest]] of [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a predatory species on Alaris Prime. The bowcaster troopers shot down two gundarks on their march to the nest but encountered [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] already [[Death/Legends|eliminating]] the creatures. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] attacked the Wookiees after dispatching all the gundarks, but the bowcaster troopers defeated them instead.<ref name="GB" />

After that incident the leader of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]]; [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], set out to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] the Trade Federation's activity on Alaris Prime, taking two bowcaster troopers with [[Gender/Legends|him]]. On his return trip to a Wookiee [[Unidentified Wookiee base (Attichitcuk's rescue)|base]] Attichitcuk was [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|ambushed]] by a group of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], who killed his trooper companions and critically injured him. To [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|save]] his [[Parent/Legends|father]] Chewbacca mustered a force<ref name="GB" /> of at least ten<ref name="Prima" /> bowcaster troopers and led them into the wilderness,<ref name="GB" /> while more bowcaster troopers were trained at the base in order to protect it. As Chewbacca and his company returned to the base with his wounded father the newly trained troops started on the path they had left on, with both groups surrounding and destroying another group of battle droids.<ref name="Prima" /> Once Attichitcuk safely arrived at the base the bowcaster troopers had to fight off an attack from three [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="GB" />

====Aggression against the Trade Federation====
{{Quote|Chewbacca has wisely decided that we must adopt the stance of our enemy to defeat them. Therefore, Chewbacca has decided that the Trade Federation will have no place on Alaris Prime.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ChewbaccaHatesFeds.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Outpost_attacking.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The attack on the Trade Federation outpost]]
Chewbacca then became the new leader of the Wookiee colonists while his father recovered, and he began a campaign to remove the Trade Federation from Alaris Prime, starting with an [[Trade Federation outpost|outpost]] that contained a droid-building troop center. He trained an army<ref name="GB" /> of twelve Wookiees, including bowcaster troopers, mounted [[dragon trooper]]s, and [[Thermal detonator trooper (Wookiee)|thermal detonator troopers]]. At the outpost the dragon and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] troopers destroyed the walls surrounding it while Chewbacca and the bowcaster troopers fired on the five B1 battle droids that guarded it. After breaking through the walls all the Wookiees concentrated their fire on the troop center and destroyed it.<ref name="GB" />

At least two bowcaster troopers were present at a [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] run by Chewbacca when it was [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attacked]] by battle droids commanded by LUH-989. These troopers fought off the droids and later participated in an [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|attack]] on a Trade Federation [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]], destroying the Federation's droids and [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]], along with one heavy bowcaster trooper from the Wookiee [[Shoran]]'s [[Shoran's camp|camp]] who was killed in the attack. Seven bowcaster troopers were present at [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]] from which the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]] was waged,<ref name="GB" /> and five heavy bowcaster troopers participated as the infantry in the attack on the Trade Federation [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]] that saw the company removed from the moon.<ref name="Prima" />

===Other conflicts===
Bowcaster troopers also fought in the [[Hunt for the Decimator]],<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> the [[Battle of Geddes]] and the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk.]]<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Click on your troop center and click "create trooper recruit."|Qui-Gon Jinn instructs the player to create bowcaster troopers|<ref name="GB" />}}
Bowcaster troopers appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' as the basic trooper unit of the Wookiee civilization. In the game they are created at troop centers for the cost of 25 [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and 35 [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]. At the beginning of the standard game mode the player can create bowcaster trooper recruits, and can upgrade them to bowcaster trooper, heavy bowcaster trooper, and repeater bowcaster troopers once the research becomes available to them as they progress through the games tech levels.<ref name="GB" />
